title: Made with Unity: gamescom 2026 recap
summary: Explore the Made with Unity Games being exhibited at gamescom 2026 in Cologne, Germany.
body_markdown:
## Unity in the Indie Arena Booth


This year marked the first time Unity had its own presence on the Gamescom consumer show floor, right in the thick of it at the Indie Arena Booth. It was amazing to see the range of games on display, and we were proud to host the following games at our booth throughout the show. A huge thank you to everyone who showed up to say hello and get their hands on the games!


*[Cairn](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1588550/Cairn/)* - Reach a summit never climbed before in this survival-climber from the creators of Furi and Haven.


[There Are No Ghosts At The Grand](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3725190/There_Are_No_Ghosts_at_the_Grand/) - Inherit a crumbling English hotel and restore it by day—while battling ghosts by night. With a sardonic cat, a talking power tool, and a twisting supernatural plot, this is a musical mystery unlike any other.


*[Outbound](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2681030/Outbound/)* - Explore a colorful world and build your own cozy home on wheels. Craft workstations, and source energy from the sun, wind, or water. Upgrade and customize your vehicle, grow crops, and live sustainably off-grid with up to 4 players.


[Paralives](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1118520/Paralives/) - Paralives is a life simulation game about building homes, lives and bonds. Through both hardship and success, where will your story take you?


[Nomori](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2932680/Nomori/) - Nomori is a mind-bending adventure game where you control time and space to journey through a whimsical spirit world. Take shortcuts through portals, rotate your perspective, and control the flow of time to solve puzzles that are out of this world.
